title: Splicky's washboard band and the union
summary: At about 13 he did a few jobs with a washboard band led by a man known only as Splicky, around the Alhambra stage acts and the union rules.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: But I understand you were in the union at thirteen.

No, I wasn't in the union yet. But I did a couple of things with Splicky's(?) band, a washboard band, you know -- a couple in Harlem. They were turning around ...(?)... And the union said... By that time the Alhambra had acts, and you were supposed to go on the stage. But when it came time to come on the stage, Splicky(?) himself was saying his man wasn't there, you know...
I don't know. He was a washboard player.
That's what we used to call him. I never knew his name.
But he played the washboard anyway.
